name: AFFiNE
description_en: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
readme_excerpt: AFFiNE.Pro Write, Draw and Plan All at Once A privacy-focused, local-first, open-source, and ready-to-use alternative for Notion & Miro. One hyper-fused platform for wildly creative minds. Home Page | Discord | Live Demo | Blog | Documentation [![All Contributors][all-contributors-badge]](#contributors) [![TypeScript-version-icon]](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) Docs, canvas and tables are hyper-merged with AFFiNE - just like the word affine (əˈfʌɪn | a-fine). Getting started & staying tuned…
